scripts.dist: (taskkill /f /fi "STATUS eq RUNNING" /im fl-launcher.exe /im java.exe /im javaw.exe /im electron.exe 2>nul || echo.>nul) & (if exist dist rmdir /s /q dist) & electron-builder
scripts.release: (taskkill /f /fi "STATUS eq RUNNING" /im fl-launcher.exe /im java.exe /im javaw.exe /im electron.exe 2>nul || echo.>nul) & (if exist dist rmdir /s /q dist) & electron-builder --publish always
